datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2019 for Yemen. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) representing medium-term food insecurity projections across administrative units, with classifications indicating severity of acute food insecurity and assistance requirements.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity levels and are used to assess humanitarian needs and food security status.
